title: Dataset scout pattern
text: Search dataset and competition surfaces for repeated schemas, labeled tasks, underused domain datasets, and high-friction workflows that could become reusable pipeline components.

title: Paper scout pattern
text: Search publications for benchmark gaps, failure studies, domain-specific workflows, new retrieval or evaluation methods, and claims that can be turned into pipeline primitives or evaluation tasks.

title: Red-team scout pattern
text: Search red-team events, hackathons, safety reports, and vulnerability writeups for recurring failure modes that can become rule packs, guardrails, adversarial datasets, or deployment gates.

title: Low-adoption scout pattern
text: Search industries, public RFPs, forums, and professional workflows where LLM adoption is low despite clear economic value because integration, trust, compliance, or verification remains difficult.

title: Cost scout pattern
text: Search pricing pages, inference benchmarks, and deployment reports for opportunities where routing, caching, local models, batch inference, browser-local models, or smaller models can lower cost without losing quality.

title: Out-of-box baseline test
text: Before promoting a primitive, test whether frontier, small hosted, and local models can solve the task without scaffolding, then measure lift from rules, retrieval, tools, rubrics, and human escalation.

title: Promotion rule
text: Promote a finding only when it has cited evidence, a clear task, a reusable component opportunity, an evaluation path, trust-boundary notes, and a plausible deployment shape.
